Field: physics
Problem description: A metallic block is suddenly brought into contact with a cold reservoir and its internal temperature relaxes toward equilibrium as heat conducts away. The evolving temperature difference and stored thermal energy jointly change over time as heat flows out. The relaxation is governed by the coupling between the block and its surroundings. The task is to evolve the temperature excess over time from an initial heated state.

[VARIABLES & PARAMETERS]:
- Target variable: dTheta_dt (rate of change of the temperature excess of the block core)
- Input features: t (time)
- Dynamic states: Theta (temperature excess of the block core above the reservoir); Theta_surf (temperature excess of the block surface layer above the reservoir)
- Parameters: tau (internal core-to-surface relaxation time constant); sigma_rad (effective radiative loss coefficient (Stefan-Boltzmann emissivity-area factor divided by heat capacity)); T_res (absolute temperature of the cold reservoir); h_nat (natural-convection loss coefficient per heat capacity); one_quarter (fixed exponent (1/4) for the natural-convection scaling); k_couple (core-to-surface conductive coupling coefficient per core heat capacity); tau_surf (surface-layer relaxation time constant to the reservoir); gamma_loss (surface-to-core conductive feedback coefficient per surface heat capacity); beta_temp (linear temperature coefficient of the metal thermal conductivity); one (dimensionless unit constant equal to one); alpha_contact (dimensionless amplification factor of contact-conductance enhancement at small core-surface temperature difference); delta_gap (characteristic core-surface temperature difference above which the enhanced contact conduction saturates and shuts off)

[CANDIDATE EQUATION]:
dTheta_dt = -Theta / tau - sigma_rad * ((Theta + T_res)**4 - T_res**4) - h_nat * Abs(Theta)**(one_quarter) * Theta - k_couple * (Theta - Theta_surf) * (one + beta_temp * Theta) - k_couple * alpha_contact * (Theta - Theta_surf) / (one + (Theta - Theta_surf)**2 / delta_gap**2)

  "time_symbol": "t",
  "target_state": "Theta",
  "states": [
    {
      "symbol": "Theta",
      "rhs": "-Theta / tau - sigma_rad * ((Theta + T_res)**4 - T_res**4) - h_nat * Abs(Theta)**(one_quarter) * Theta - k_couple * (Theta - Theta_surf) * (one + beta_temp * Theta) - k_couple * alpha_contact * (Theta - Theta_surf) / (one + (Theta - Theta_surf)**2 / delta_gap**2)",
      "initial_condition": 100.0,
      "description": "temperature excess of the block core above the reservoir"
    },

      "symbol": "Theta_surf",
      "rhs": "gamma_loss * (Theta - Theta_surf) * (one + beta_temp * Theta_surf) - Theta_surf / tau_surf - sigma_rad * ((Theta_surf + T_res)**4 - T_res**4) - h_nat * Abs(Theta_surf)**(one_quarter) * Theta_surf",
      "initial_condition": 100.0,
      "description": "temperature excess of the block surface layer above the reservoir"
    }
  ]
}
